notes: Four tabs at the bottom: Chat, Ideas, Goals and Files, so the main things are one tap away
Settings is its own page now, with a Back button and compact grouped rows, instead of a long drop-down
Goals have their own tab, with an Add a goal button
A new modern black background in dark mode: a deep slate with a soft glow and a little texture instead of flat black
Big emoji, like the weather on Ervo Stats and the status icons, show as 3D pictures
While Ervo writes, you see its picture and name with three bouncing dots, like someone typing. What it's doing still shows at the top
Change how Ervo looks: tap Ervo's picture at the top (or the menu) and pick from 10 looks, like Gamer, Space, Winter or Business
Weather before you leave (Android): pick when you usually head out, and about 20 minutes before, Ervo sends one heads-up only if there's rain, snow, storms, wind, heat or cold
Calorie questions like "how many calories in a spicy wrap and large fries" get real numbers for each item and a total, instead of your steps
Product picks always show a picture now, even when the store doesn't share one
Share long answers like meal plans straight to Notes, email or messages. Ervo no longer says it saved a file it can't make
Thumbs up or down on Ervo's answers. Tell it "Too long" or "Wrong info" and it learns from that
